WITH fan_data AS (
  SELECT 
    f.userregistry,
    f.nicklabel,
    f.tierstep,
    m.spendusd,
    m.membdays,
    COALESCE(i.gifttot_sum, 0) as gifttot,
    e.engrate,
    e.socintscore,
    e.actdayswk,
    e.avgsesscount,
    r.churnflag
  FROM fans f
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON m.memberfanpivot = f.userregistry
  JOIN engagement e ON e.engagememberpivot = m.memberreg
  LEFT JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON r.retainengagepivot = e.engagereg
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT interactfanpivot, SUM(gifttot) as gifttot_sum
    FROM interactions
    WHERE interactfanpivot IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY interactfanpivot
  ) i ON i.interactfanpivot = f.userregistry
),
fan_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    userregistry,
    nicklabel,
    tierstep,
    spendusd,
    membdays,
    gifttot,
    engrate,
    socintscore,
    actdayswk,
    avgsesscount,
    churnflag,
    -- FEI calculation
    (engrate * 0.4 + (socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3 + (actdayswk::numeric / 7.0) * 0.2 + (avgsesscount::numeric / 10.0) * 0.1) as fei,
    -- RRF mapping
    CASE WHEN churnflag = 'None' THEN 0 
         WHEN churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1 
         WHEN churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2 
         WHEN churnflag = 'High' THEN 3 
         ELSE 0 END as rrf_numeric,
    -- MV calculation
    spendusd * (1 + membdays::numeric / 365.0 * 0.5) * (1 + gifttot::numeric / 10.0 * 0.2) as mv
  FROM fan_data
),
fan_flv AS (
  SELECT 
    userregistry,
    nicklabel,
    tierstep,
    ROUND(CAST(mv * (1 - rrf_numeric::numeric / 10.0) * (1 + fei) * 24 AS numeric), 2) as flv
  FROM fan_metrics
)
SELECT 
  userregistry,
  nicklabel,
  tierstep,
  flv,
  CASE 
    WHEN flv > PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY flv) OVER () THEN 'Top Tier'
    WHEN flv > PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY flv) OVER () THEN 'High Value'
    WHEN flv >= PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY flv) OVER () THEN 'Medium Value'
    ELSE 'Low Value'
  END as fan_value_category
FROM fan_flv
ORDER BY flv;

         WHEN churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2 
         WHEN churnflag = 'High' THEN 3 
         ELSE 0 END as rrf_numeric,
    spendusd * (1 + membdays::numeric / 365.0 * 0.5) * (1 + gifttot::numeric / 10.0 * 0.2) as mv
  FROM fan_data
),
fan_flv AS (
  SELECT 
    userregistry,
    nicklabel,
    tierstep,
    ROUND(CAST(mv * (1 - rrf_numeric::numeric / 10.0) * (1 + fei) * 24 AS numeric), 2) as flv
  FROM fan_metrics
),
percentiles AS (
  SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY flv)::numeric as p90,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY flv)::numeric as p75,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY flv)::numeric as p50
  FROM fan_flv
)
SELECT 
  ff.userregistry,
  ff.nicklabel,
  ff.tierstep,
  ff.flv,
  CASE 
    WHEN ff.flv > p.p90 THEN 'Top Tier'
    WHEN ff.flv > p.p75 THEN 'High Value'
    WHEN ff.flv >= p.p50 THEN 'Medium Value'
    ELSE 'Low Value'
  END as fan_value_category
FROM fan_flv ff, percentiles p
ORDER BY ff.flv;
